description: He wears a cream long linen robe with richly embroidered gold neckline and front border beneath a dark brown open-front coat with elaborate gold geometric edging and broad sleeves. A black-gold woven sash with decorated round clasp and fringed hanging ends wraps the waist. Loose cream trousers and brown-gold embroidered leather boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
